name: Jesús Ramírez Nava
positioning: I build C/C++ systems that have to work — embedded firmware, device ports, and the APIs and AI backends that sit on top of them.
bio: Senior software engineer with 10 years in C/C++ — from 16-bit microcontrollers and CAN bus tooling at John Deere to Amazon Fire TV middleware and API backends today. I've led teams of 10+ engineers, served as Scrum Master, and designed the simulators, test tooling, and backends other teams depend on. Independently, I build web and AI products for clients. Based in Monterrey (UTC-6) and open to remote work with US teams.
